args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST
June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel documents (flight confirmations, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera with extra batteries/memory cards
- Travel insurance information
- Medications and prescriptions
- Reusable water bottle

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners and shopping
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Hiking shoes/boots (for Diamond Head hike)
- Hat with brim for sun protection
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towel
- Beach bag
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Waterproof phone case
- Rash guard or UV protective swim shirt
- Dry bag for valuables

OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Hiking gear (backpack, water, snacks)
- Sunscreen (reef-safe, high SPF)
- Insect repellent
- Portable first aid kit
- Day pack for excursions

TOILETRIES:
- Toiletries (travel-sized)
- Hairbrush/comb
- Deodorant
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera gel

ELECTRONICS:
- Laptop/tablet (optional)
- Universal power adapter
- Power bank
- Headphones

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Books or e-reader
- Travel pillow
- Snacks for travel days
- Small backpack for day trips
- Laundry bag
- Travel laundry detergent (for longer stays)

Based on planned activities:
- June 11: Beach day at Waikiki Beach → Beach essentials
- June 12: Snorkeling at Hanauma Bay → Snorkeling gear, waterproof camera
- June 13: Hiking at Diamond Head → Proper hiking shoes, water, sun protection
- June 14: Visit to Pearl Harbor → Comfortable walking shoes, respectful attire
- June 15: Road trip to the North Shore → Car essentials, snacks, cooler
- June 16: Luau experience → Hawaiian shirt/dress (aloha attire)
- June 17: Relaxation day at hotel spa → Spa-appropriate attire
- June 18: Kayaking at Kailua Beach → Quick-dry clothing, water shoes
- June 19: Shopping at Ala Moana Center → Comfortable shopping attire
- June 20: Departure → Organized luggage, travel documents easily accessible
